measurements.origin: Natural Park of Montesinho territory, in Trás-os-Montes, North-eastern Portugal
measurements.equipment: Hewlett-Packard 1100 chromatograph (Agilent Technologies) with a quaternary pump and a diode array detector (DAD) coupled to an HP Chem Station (rev. A.05.04) data-processing station

measurements.plant_part: flower buds with top young leaves (corymbs); unripe fruits corresponding to flower senescence and stand out of the green pomaceous (berry-like) immature fruit; ripened fruits i.e. red pomes in late summer; over ripened fruits i.e. dark red, fleshy, sweet, chewy and coarse-textured pomes in late autumn
measurements.cultivar_variety: a) Unripened fruit; b) Ripened fruit; c) Over ripened fruit
measurements.equipment: Hewlett-Packard 1100 chromatograph (Agilent Technologies) with a quaternary pump and a diode array detector (DAD) coupled to an HP Chem Station (rev. A.05.04) data-processing station
measurements.citation: Rodrigues et al., 2012. Food Research International, 49, 516-523
